outcomes.name: Understanding of the organisational change readiness has been assessed across all live sites/teams
The organisational change readiness is consistently applied everywhere the change has gone live

actions.action: Recognise that Strategic Direction & Leadership is inconsistent across teams/sites since go-live and gather evidence of where the gaps are in the organisational change readiness.
Identify why the organisational change readiness hasn't landed consistently for Strategic Direction & Leadership in specific teams/sites and agree a plan to address it.
Re-engage leaders in lagging teams/sites to re-establish the organisational change readiness for Strategic Direction & Leadership.
Confirm the organisational change readiness for Strategic Direction & Leadership is being applied consistently across previously inconsistent areas.
Monitor Strategic Direction & Leadership regularly to ensure the organisational change readiness stays consistently reinforced everywhere.
Survey teams/sites to understand how Skills & Behaviour has been affected by inconsistent organisational change readiness since go-live.
Develop a targeted plan to address the specific Skills & Behaviour-related gaps identified in lagging areas.
Deliver targeted support to strengthen Skills & Behaviour in teams/sites where the organisational change readiness is weakest.
Confirm Skills & Behaviour has improved in previously lagging teams/sites.
Embed regular pulse-checks on Skills & Behaviour so gaps in the organisational change readiness are caught early in future.
